data.name: County Hospital Outbreak
data.detailed_description:
Survive the ultimate outbreak in this 4-player co-op horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5. Explore a new hospital and two famous psychiatric hospitals from the saga in the aftermath of a fire. Manage your resources and use flamethrowers to eradicate a massive organic infestation, destroying the 'Mother Organism' by launching the emergency protocol in SOLO mode or with friends hosting and joining
Explore and enjoy this sci-fi horror indie game, created with passion by a solo developer
5 years have passed since the old county hospitals were reduced to ashes by an independent researcher.
Those same facilities have been rebuilt to experiment on an unknown organism discovered in ancient caves. The experiment has spiraled out of control, infecting everyone on-site and the hospitals. An elite special forces team has been deployed with one mission: destroy the Mother Organism and wipe out every last trace

In County Hospital Outbreak, you return to the ruins of the previous incidents, but this time, you aren’t alone. A localized outbreak of unknown organisms has overtaken the facility, and your mission is clear: total eradication

  • 4-Player Online Co-op or SOLO: Form your squad and survive together. Get fun watch each other's backs while purging the outbreak and exploring. Immerse yourself in a solo campaign or work as a team, using flamethrowers and grenades to complete 8 interconnected objectives: photograph organisms, restore power, burn specimens, find keycards, scavenge for disks and batteries, activate systems, and cleanse the facility with friends or on your own

  • Next-Gen Visuals (UE5): Experience professional-grade detail with Nanite and Lumen high-fidelity dynamic lighting—all optimized in a lightweight 10 GB package, maintaining a stable 60 FPS on an AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT or equivalent

  • Unique Survival Mechanics:

    • Phase 1: Investigation: Use your camera to collect photos and evidence before the true chaos begins.

    • Thermal Combat: Manage your energy bar and wield flamethrowers to burn over 60 reactive infection clusters and organisms.

    • Retro Interaction: Operate vintage computers using floppy disks and security cards to unlock secret underground laboratories.

  • Original 80s Soundtrack: Deepen your immersion with original tracks composed with classic synthesizers and keyboards, specifically designed to heighten the tension in every corridor.

  • Escalating Horror: Move from silent exploration to a frantic climax. Fight off zombie hordes that react to fire and prepare for the final showdown against the towering Mother Organism.

  • Seamless Steam Integration: Invite friends directly through your Steam friends list and use built-in voice systems to plan your eradication strategy.

  • Continuous Updates & Community Driven

    Why support this game?

    I am a solo developer fueled by a lifelong passion for gaming. Growing up with the classics on NES, SNES, and PC shaped my vision, and I’m pouring my soul into this project. Even though this isn't an Early Access title, I am fully committed to its evolution. I personally monitor the Steam Discussion forums every day to see what you think and discover what else can be added. I’m constantly creating new maps, enemies, and features based on player feedback. By purchasing the game, you ensure you get all these constant updates and directly support my journey as a solo dev.

    SUPPORT REAL INDIES!!
    Another fine release from LFR Games

data.short_description: Co-op or solo sci-fi horror. Purge a biological outbreak with flamethrowers & grenades. Explore infested zones, grab keycards & stuff, then trigger the protocol to burn the Mother Organism. Team up. Erase the threat

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3 or similar
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i9 or similar
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070 Super
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: You destroy semi-naked zombies with a flamethrower
